boundaries.cpu: Native app /proc CPU ticks during measured interval,100% is one logical core. Startup/warmup/finalization/Python/independent media decoding excluded from that CPU rate. Codec-overload cases mostly measure resumed numeric processing after an explicit video stop, not ongoing successful video encoding.
boundaries.quality: Actual cameras/live scene varies; complete quality and numeric rows retained. Physical accuracy is established separately on fixed VR3 video, not inferred from these live cases.
boundaries.clock: Per-take source-clock diagnostics include initial/control transitions/retained starting rows. Nominal missing-interval estimates are not verified sensor loss or a causal mode attribution.
boundaries.duration: H264 and MJPEG4s measured after1s warmup per case; raw2s measured after1s warmup per case. Source-clock evidence includes warmup/startup. Short clips do not prove indefinite disk throughput. Filesystem caches were not flushed.
boundaries.completed_video: Each complete or partial file independently decoded in full. Complete count must equal all numeric/quality rows. Prefix must have explicit stopped_overload state, finalized .partial, no final path, and exact first/last source IDs/timestamps.
boundaries.wire: Real libzmq healthy subscriber, undrained subscriber and recurring incomplete-greeting peer per camera. Every accepted recorded row matched exact FT bytes in order; rejected rows remain only in complete numeric/quality output by contract.
boundaries.cleanup: Only generated raw AVI bytes removed after full decode/count/hash and saved source-bound/manifest verification plus first/last PNG excerpts; originals untouched.

exact_renderer_phase.boundary: Serial saved native PNGs, unchanged frame repeated; PNG read/decode and initial warmup render excluded. Direct render includes validation, geometry construction, remap, overlays, allocation. Cached render excludes one-time validated geometry construction but includes dynamic views/overlays, RGB sampling, and allocation. Codec write includes RGB conversion, encode, packet drain and AVI write; init/finalization separately timed. No capture, tracking, UI, or concurrency; not sustained camera FPS.
